own_result_audit.derivative_erratum: The INITIAL derivative formula had a spurious /alpha! factor; correct derivative factor is (-1)^|alpha| |alpha|! tau^(|alpha|+2). Equality claim survives by exact moment matching. Original script computed Taylor coefficients, not raw derivatives.
own_result_audit.interface_clarification: Atomic reference experiment has positive analytic RN likelihood relative to its own finite reference measure, not a positive Lebesgue density on the cube. Decoder must be parameter-blind.
own_result_audit.status: REPAIRED_INTERNAL_CANDIDATE; finite-jet equality and archive gap derivations survive; no external priority/correctness validation.

synthesis: The useful acquisition quantity is posterior-decision regret under chosen parameter priors/tasks. Uniform-TV reconstruction forces small regret for every bounded proper loss; a posterior rate-distortion lower bound then bounds any classical/hybrid/quantum memory. Positive upper bounds need an explicit reference-preserving codec. c09_l03 supplies one sufficient joint-density condition, while c09_s02/c09_l04 and c09_l10 show finite Fisher information alone is insufficient in different senses.

prior_art_boundary.hayashi_tan: Primary-source paper specifies blind distribution-reconstruction codes and variational-distance error, but its main d/2 log n rate is an n-iid asymptotic rather than this single-draw epsilon-to-zero finite-jet pair. https://arxiv.org/html/1612.02542v2
prior_art_boundary.varshney_varshney: Bayes-risk distortion for quantizing prior probabilities in hypothesis testing is direct decision-theoretic-quantization antecedent; the general posterior-regret lemma is not claimed as novel. https://arxiv.org/abs/0805.4338
prior_art_boundary.buscemi: Quantum Blackwell-Sherman-Stein sufficiency framework is relevant prior art; no novelty claim for decision-theoretic characterization. https://arxiv.org/abs/1004.3794v4
prior_art_boundary.tchakaloff: Positive finite cubature matching polynomial moments is established Tchakaloff/Caratheodory theory; only its use in the present archive comparison is the candidate application. https://doi.org/10.1016/S0022-247X(02)00034-3

remaining_gate: Weaker broadly reusable joint-posterior hypothesis with a constructive acquired codec and explicit sampler, precision, random-bit, and runtime costs; novelty and external verification unresolved.
